meta.environment: demo (mock funds per the official demo page)

definitions.dollar_ranking: 24 h traded notional: SUM(yes_price_dollars x count_fp) over GET /markets/trades in the previous 24 h, per market (committed snapshot field dollar_notional_24h; each row carries the request URL that produced it)
definitions.swing: two consecutive observations of the same market whose YES price differs by >= $0.10 in either direction
definitions.price_axis: y = contract price in dollars ($0.00-$1.00); x = time
definitions.liquidity: resting contracts per price level from GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook; the endpoint returns yes bids and no bids only, and a no bid at x is a yes ask at 1-x (per the official order-book page)
definitions.resolution: YES/NO is reported only when the market's live status is `finalized`; a market at `determined` or `disputed` carries a result that may still change (official lifecycle page)
definitions.candles: GET /series/{s}/markets/{t}/candlesticks with period_interval 1, 60 or 1440 minutes only
definitions.fee: taker fee = round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)), M=1, C=1 (official fee schedule)

exchange_status.observed: exchange_active=true; trading_active=true; intra_exchange_transfers_active=true; four index statuses returned (Default, Demo shard 1, Demo shard 2, one without a description), each with trading_active=true

trades_tape.observed: HTTP 200 without credentials; newest trade stamped 2026-11-20T19:46:42.691948Z (i.e. the tape is live); fields seen per trade: ticker, yes_price_dollars, no_price_dollars, count_fp, created_time, taker_side, taker_book_side, taker_outcome_side, is_block_trade, trade_id; a `cursor` is returned

shard_probe.observed: HTTP 200; a different, valid trade set (KXMARMAD-27-UVA, KXPGAR2LEAD-THRC26-HLEB, KXPRESPERSON-28-JVAN) stamped 2026-11-20T19:49:16Z. The five markets checked with GET /markets/... all report exchange_index 0, so on the demo venue the production shard table on the official sharding page does not describe these series.

model.name: tape-desk follow-through rule (transparent, not a forecast)
model.rule_p: market already present in sim-desk/data/ledger.json (positions_open / trades_settled)
model.rule_b: side YES after an up-jump, NO after a down-jump; entry = the post-jump price; win probability = the resolved-YES frequency of that price bucket measured on the settled demo markets in the committed engine settlement study (band sample size shown on every pick); cost = entry + the official taker fee; a pick is flagged only when expected ROI > 0
model.rule_e: executability: the side being taken must have a live quote with a non-zero resting size, otherwise the pick is suppressed as NOT-EXECUTABLE
model.rule_n: bands with fewer than 20 resolved markets are never used
model.engine_status_label: SIMULATED — no orders were placed; no demo API key exists in this repo
engine_caveats: Demo venue: mock funds, and Kalshi states demo prices/behavior may not reflect real markets (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/demo_env).
Candle coverage is only the markets the collector captured; results are not a market-wide statistic and the sample is small.
Entry/exit use candle close-level quotes, which is the finest detail the public REST API offers; intrabar fills and queue priority are not modelled.
model.honesty: This is a published rule over demo data, not a profit claim: the same official fee formula and settlement study are printed next to every pick so the reader can disagree.
